name: erb-b2 receptor tyrosine kinase 3

function.text: ERBB3 encodes receptor tyrosine-protein kinase erbB-3. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and neuregulin receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and negative regulation of signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to lethal congenital contracture syndrome 2 (autosomal recessive); visceral neuropathy, familial, 1, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: ERBB3 amplification and/or overexpression has been reported in several cancers, including prostate, bladder, and breast tumors; expression and sequence-mutation findings require separate interpretation.
